title: Two Furthest Houses With Different Colors
summary: Given an array of house colors, find the greatest distance between houses of different colors.
statement: Given an array of house colors, find the greatest distance between houses of different colors. The distance is the absolute difference in their indices.
constraints: At least two houses are given and adjacent houses may share colors.
Distance is the absolute index difference; choose two houses with different colors.
hints: At least one member of an optimal pair can be replaced by an endpoint without reducing distance.
Compare every house to the first and last colors while tracking the largest endpoint distance.
If color differs from first use index; if it differs from last use n-1-index.
For any different-colored pair, at least one color differs from the opposite endpoint, whose distance is no smaller.
editorial: For any different-colored pair, at least one color differs from the opposite endpoint, whose distance is no smaller.

tests.explanation: The differently colored house at index three is distance three from either endpoint.
The endpoints have different colors, giving the maximum possible distance four.
